items.title: Zero-Downtime Deployment Pipeline
items.summary: Re-engineered the release process to eliminate downtime windows entirely.
items.problem: Weekly deploys required a scheduled maintenance window and a manual rollback plan, causing customer-facing downtime and on-call fatigue every release cycle.
items.solution: Migrated from a monolithic Jenkins pipeline to a GitOps model on ArgoCD, introducing progressive delivery — canary and blue/green rollouts — gated by automated health checks on Kubernetes.
items.role: Led the migration end-to-end: pipeline redesign, rollout strategy, and rollback tooling, in collaboration with two backend teams.
items.keyDetail: Reduced deployment time by 70% and eliminated release-window downtime entirely.

items.title: Multi-Cloud Infrastructure-as-Code Framework
items.summary: Standardized provisioning across AWS and Azure under one Terraform framework.
items.problem: Infrastructure was hand-provisioned differently per cloud, leading to configuration drift, inconsistent environments, and slow onboarding for new services.
items.solution: Designed a modular Terraform framework with shared conventions, remote state management, and reusable modules abstracted across AWS and Azure providers.
items.role: Owned framework architecture and module design; wrote adoption guidelines used by three product teams.
items.keyDetail: Cut new-environment provisioning time from days to under two hours.

items.title: Observability Stack Overhaul
items.summary: Rebuilt monitoring from scattered dashboards into one coherent signal.
items.problem: Incidents were often discovered by customers before engineers; existing dashboards didn't correlate metrics, logs, and traces in one place.
items.solution: Deployed Prometheus and Loki behind unified Grafana dashboards, with alert thresholds tuned to user impact and runbooks linked directly from every alert.
items.role: Designed the alerting taxonomy and led rollout across five services, training on-call engineers on the new dashboards.

items.title: Self-Healing Kubernetes Cluster
items.summary: Automated recovery from the failures that used to page someone at 2 a.m.
items.problem: Common node and pod failures required manual remediation, consuming on-call hours on repetitive, entirely scriptable fixes.
items.solution: Built Helm-packaged operators and ArgoCD-managed self-healing policies covering automatic pod rescheduling, node cordoning, and resource-pressure eviction.
items.role: Designed and implemented the self-healing policies; documented failure classes and escalation paths for the remaining edge cases.
